lines.text: A delay and a connection to catch.
Do the arithmetic, join the line and call at the same time, and ask for a specific flight, not for help.

head.text: Ask a flight attendant whether the connecting flight is holding or whether other passengers are on it.
Open the airline app before you stand up.

body.text: Rebooking is sometimes offered there before an agent is free.

head.text: Join the service or transfer desk queue, even if the gate might still work.

body.text: You can always leave a line.

head.text: Call the airline from the queue.

body.text: The phone and the desk are separate lines.

head.text: Decide what to ask for: the next flight, a different routing, or a night in a hotel.

items.text: Booking reference, and the name it's under.
Your onward flight number and its departure time.
Whether both flights are on one booking.
What's waiting at the other end: a transfer, a check-in, someone meeting you.
Paper or a second device to write on, because your phone may be at eleven percent.

line.text: The connection, the transfer and whatever was booked after them are shown as potentially affected, with a walked-through call for any that need one.
